messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
On the way there I was listening to the radio and they said to call in with your scariest story.

output.original_text: On the way there I was listening to the radio and they said to call in with your scariest story.
output.joy: On the way there, I joyfully listened to the radio, and they invited listeners to call in with their scariest story!
output.sadness: On the way there, I was listening to the radio, and they mentioned calling in with your scariest story, which felt oddly heavy and lonely.
output.fear: On the way there, I nervously listened to the radio, and they warned to call in with your scariest story, sending chills down my spine.
output.anger: On the way there, I was fuming while listening to the radio as they demanded listeners to call in with their scariest story—so frustrating!
output.surprise: On the way there, I was shocked to hear on the radio that they wanted callers to share their scariest story!
output.disgust: On the way there, I was listening to the radio and felt repulsed when they encouraged listeners to call in with their scariest story.
